Staffing: Wren out; Pia covering. Mira out; Esme covering. Jonah out; Bram covering.

- Print room: Umbrella left. Free morning. Repainting (noise morning). Coffee working. Lift slow.
- Harbour room: Coffee working. Keep clear for Cora/Una’s visitors. Repainting (noise morning). Umbrella left. Lift slow today. Evening stand-up moved here. Rafe notes: too cold afternoon. Free in afternoon.
- East wing: Too cold all day. Repainting (noise evening). Keep clear for Teo’s, Hugo’s, and Opal’s visitors. Lift slow. Umbrella left. Coffee working.

Other: Hugo wants east wing kept clear for visitors. Need to send Leon morning meeting notes. Pending tasks unchanged. Check with Una before morning meeting.
